title: Archive
description: Archive structure inventories represent earlier versions of the inventory in conformance. The NSI year should reflect the year or version of the NSI, and the price-level year should reflect the price year if prices are indexed. The archive date is represented by yyyymmdd. The README gives the naming convention as <modeling-unit>-nsiyyyy-pricelevelyyyy-yyyymmmdd.gpkg, with an extra m in the date pattern compared with its date explanation.
